function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films across various sub‑genres—so you’ll have something whether you’re into psychological dread, supernatural chills, or gore‑heavy thrills:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|-----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological / Gothic | Kubrick’s masterful build‑up of isolation and madness. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Supernatural / Family | A chilling look at grief and inherited trauma with a truly unsettling climax. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social Thriller | Sharp satire wrapped in a tense, genre‑savvy horror story. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Folk Horror | Daylight terror that turns a pastoral festival into a nightmare. |
| 5 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Survival / Sci‑Fi | Silence is survival; the tension never lets up. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Creepy / Modern | A simple premise turned into a relentless, atmospheric dread. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological / Supernatural | A metaphorical take on grief that feels genuinely scary. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal | Well‑crafted scares with a strong narrative backbone. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Slasher / Supernatural | A viral curse that’s both creepy and iconic. |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑Horror | A clever twist on the “cabin‑in‑the‑woods” trope. |
|11 | **Suspiria** | 1977 | Giallo / Supernatural | Visually stunning, haunting atmosphere. |
|12 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Period / Supernatural | Slow‑burn dread set in Puritan New England. |
|13 | **The Descent** | 2005 | Cave / Survival | Intense claustrophobia and creature horror. |
|14 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found Footage | Low‑budget ingenuity that still terrifies. |
|15 | **The Others** | 2001 | Gothic / Mystery | A twisty, moody thriller with a memorable reveal. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a slow‑burn psychological scare or a fast‑paced jump‑scare binge!
